prompt: Create an ultra-minimal, charmingly clumsy hand-drawn doodle of a cute white cat on a clean pure white paper background. Show a close-up portrait with the head filling most of the square canvas, slightly cropped at the body, with two tall pointed ears, a rounded face, simple whiskers, and a tiny straight-line smile. Use messy black pen scribble line art with imperfect repeated contour lines and uneven hatching. Add rough crayon coloring: pale cream-white fur, black scribbled markings across the top of the head and around one side of the face, soft pink inside both ears, a pink nose, and large round glossy eyes with golden yellow rings and black scribbled pupils with small white highlights. Keep the style deliberately sloppy, childlike, cute, minimal, and airy, with lots of blank white space, no text, no border, no realistic rendering, and no polished vector lines.

promptZh: 在干净纯白的纸张背景上，创作一幅超极简、充满童趣且略显笨拙的手绘涂鸦，主角是一只可爱的 白猫。展示一张特写肖像，头部占据方形画布的大部分区域，身体略微裁切，画出两只高耸的尖耳朵、圆润的脸庞、简单的胡须以及一条细小的直线微笑。使用凌乱的黑色钢笔涂鸦线条，线条带有不完美的重复轮廓和不均匀的排线。添加粗糙的蜡笔着色：淡奶油色的毛发，头顶和脸部一侧带有 黑色 的涂鸦斑点，双耳内侧为柔和的粉色，粉色的鼻子，以及带有 金黄色 圆环、黑色涂鸦瞳孔和白色小高光的大而圆的亮眼。保持风格刻意随性、稚拙、可爱、极简且留白丰富，无文字，无边框，拒绝写实渲染，拒绝精致的矢量线条。
